entities.name: Charles Darwin
entities.description: English naturalist Charles Darwin, known for his contributions to evolutionary biology, spent the summer of 1825 as an apprentice doctor in Shropshire and later studied at the University of Edinburgh Medical School. He learned taxidermy from John Edmonstone, a Black Briton who had been taught by Charles Waterton, and found lectures dull and surgery distressing.

entities.name: theory of evolution
entities.description: A scientific theory explaining the process of natural selection.

entities.name: barnacles
entities.description: A group of marine crustaceans that Darwin studied obsessively.

relations.description: Charles Darwin is related to the theory of evolution.

communities.description: This community focuses on Charles Darwin's work, his studies of barnacles, and the theory of evolution that he developed.
